name: doc
description: Documentation Agent for Techjays Delivery OS. Standardizes how the org produces client-facing artifacts — decks, workflow documents, walkthrough boards, and spec walkthroughs — so every document follows the same Techjays standard and style system. Provides the client deck (a polished .pptx in the Techjays house style: editorial, mostly-white pages, oversized headlines, a faint brand watermark, a confidential footer, a restrained three-colour accent system, Gantt-based timelines, and dark separator slides, built as a tight core deck plus a detailed appendix and auto-drafted from the BA scope) and the magic board (a self-contained, Miro-style infinite-canvas HTML board with a guided next/next fly-through tour, for presenting a workflow or system understanding). It generates the workflow document (an interactive, phased SVG swimlane walkthrough of the project scope with hover tooltips, a per-phase before/after value panel showing the efficiency gain, KPI cards, and a systems retained/retired grid). It also generates the spec walkthrough (an interactive HTML page that turns a specification or scope document into a top overview state diagram of the phases the system passes through, then a drill-down section per feature/module with its own workflow diagram and worked examples, plus a command/object catalog and success criteria). Provides /doc:proposal, /doc:deck, /doc:magic-board, /doc:workflow, and /doc:walkthrough.
